The company's diverse product portfolio includes admixtures and curing compounds for concrete, tile adhesives, tile jointing grouts, waterproofing systems, ready-mix plasters, and ready-mix mortars.

MEESHO.NS.d: Meesho Ltd., set up in 2015, with its head office in Bengaluru, operates an e-commerce marketplace in India. Its platform, also called Meesho, connects sellers and consumers and offers categories such as apparel, footwear, accessories, home furnishings and kitchenware.

MTEDUCARE.NS.d: MT Educare Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides education support and coaching services in India. The company offers courses for school, science, and commerce education, as well as management entrance test preparations under the Robomate+, Lakshya, Mahesh Tutorials School Section, Mahesh Tutorials Science, Mahesh Tutorials Commerce, and CPLC brand names. It also operates college under Mahesh PU College brand name. Further, the company engages in the business of acquiring and leasing properties.

MUTHOOTCAP.NS.d: Muthoot Capital Services Limited, a non-banking finance company (NBFC), provides fund and non-fund based financial services. The company offers two wheeler, used car, consumer durable, secured business, term, and loyalty loans; short-term and long-term deposit plans; and subordinated debts, as well as advisory services. It is also involved in buying loan portfolio of other NBFCs/micro finance companies. The company serves retail, corporate, and institutional customers through a network of branches in India.

MUTHOOTMF.NS.d: Muthoot Microfin Ltd is a non-banking financial company that does not take deposits and lends small amounts to women entrepreneurs in rural India. Its loans include Pragathi, individual and income generating loans, loans for education, mobile phones, solar lighting and household appliances, sanitation loans and secured loans, along with insurance add-ons.

NFL.NS.d: National Fertilizers Limited produces and sells urea products, industrial products, and bio-fertilizers in India. It operates through Own Fertilizers, Fertilizers Trading, and Other Products & Services segments.

NITIRAJ-SM.NS.d: Nitiraj Engineers Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and supply of incense sticks (agarbatti) and related products. They offer a variety of fragrances and packaging options for their products. The company is based in India.

NITYAS.NS.d: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker NITYAS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NKIND.NS.d: N.K Industries Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in castor oil and its derivatives in India. Its products include commercial grade castor oil, cold pressed castor oil, castor oil British Pharma 93 grade, castor Hi protein, first pressed degummed castor oil, pale pressed grade, sodium sulphate anhydrous, refined castor oil, crude glycerin, de oiled cakes-castor meals, 12-hydroxy stearic acid, ricinoleic acid, hydrogenated castor oil flakes/powder, and high protein castor meal.

PENIND.NS.d: Pennar Industries Limited operates as an engineering company in India and internationally. The company offers cold rolled steel strips; electrostatic precipitator electrodes; building components, such as purlins, roofing/cladding sheets, and decking profiles; metal crash barriers for flyovers, bridges, national highways, and other projects; sheet piles for infrastructure projects; and sheet metal products for the automobile industry.

PHILIPCARB.NS.d: PCBL Limited, sells, and exports carbon black in India and internationally. The company operates through Carbon Black and Power segments. It offers various carbon black grades for the rubber industry.

PROV.NS.d: Proventus Agrocom Ltd. is an integrated health-food company specializing in the sourcing, processing, and distribution of dry fruits, nuts, seeds, and berries. The company operates within the healthy snacking segment, following a "farm-to-fork" model that encompasses global origination, processing in its integrated facilities, and retail branding under its "ProV" brand.

RVTH.NS.d: Revathi Equipment India Ltd. makes and distributes drilling machinery worldwide. Its products include blast hole drills (rotary and down-the-hole types, powered by diesel or electricity) for mining, jackless drills for construction and mining, water well drills and hydro-fracturing rigs.

SAYAJIIND.NS.d: Sayaji Industries Limited is an Indian company involved in the manufacturing of food processing machinery and distillery equipment. They also produce chemicals, including enzymes and biofuels. The company caters to the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and distillery industries and is headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.

SEPC.NS.d: SEPC Limited, formerly Shriram EPC Limited, is a Chennai-headquartered engineering and construction firm incorporated in 2000. It delivers turnkey projects in India and abroad, building industrial plants for metals, cement and process industries, water and sewage treatment facilities, and biomass, thermal and wind power plants. It also supplies engineering services for mining and mineral processing.

SHANKESH.NS.d: Shankesh Jewellers Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHANKESH and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHREDIGCEM.NS.d: Shree Digvijay Cement Company Ltd. manufactures and sells cement in India. The company's products include ordinary Portland cement, Portland Pozzolana cement, sulphate resisting Portland cement, oil well cement, and other cements. It sell its products under the KAMAL CEMENT and CEMENT KA SARDAR brands. The company was founded in 1942 and is based in Jamnagar, India. Shree Digvijay Cement Company Ltd. is a subsidiary of True North Fund VI LLP.

SILLYMONKS.NS.d: Silly Monks Entertainment Limited operates as an entertainment and media company in India. It is involved in the digital media publishing; movie/series/music/other creator content production; celebrity digital management; marketing and promotion on digital and traditional mediums; content distribution and syndication on satellite channels, cinema theatres, airborne, and other offline platforms; and online/digital advertising with Google AdWords.

SSWL.NS.d: Steel Strips Wheels Limited designs, manufactures, and sells automotive steel wheel rims and alloy wheel rims in India and internationally. It offers wheels for two and three wheelers, passenger cars, multi utility vehicles, tractors, off road vehicles, and light and heavy commercial vehicles, as well as provides alloy wheels rims for passenger cars, and MUV's and caravan vehicles. Steel Strips Wheels Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.

SUKHJITS.NS.d: The Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Limited, set up in 1943, with its head office in Phagwara, India, makes and supplies starch and its derivatives. It has four divisions: Starch and Its Derivatives, Readymade Garments, Leasing and Hire Purchase Financing, and Manufacturing of Heavy Machinery. Its products include maize starch.

SUNDARMFIN.NS.d: Sundaram Finance Limited provides a range of financial services in India. The company accepts fixed, cumulative, and NRI deposits. It also offers finance for new and used cars, new and used commercial vehicles, and new and used construction equipment; diesel finance for commercial vehicle operators and companies; tire and insurance finance; finance for new/used tractors, harvesters, and farm implements; working capital, enterprise business, and machinery term loans, as well as channel finance; housing finance; and…

SWARAJ.NS.d: Swaraj Suiting Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SWARAJ and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TAJGVK.NS.d: TAJGVK Hotels & Resorts Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels, palaces, and resorts under the Taj brand in India. It operates Taj Krishna, a 5-star hotel with 260 rooms, Taj Banjara with 122 rooms, Taj Deccan with 151 rooms, and Vivanta by Taj, a five star hotel with 181 rooms in Hyderabad. The company also operates Taj Chandigarh with 149 rooms in Chandigarh; Taj Club House with 220 rooms in Chennai; and Taj Santacruz with 279 rooms in Mumbai.

TARAPUR.NS.d: Tarapur Transformers Limited engages in the manufacture, repair, refurbishment, and upliftment of transformers in India. The company offers power transformers, such as systems, generator, auto, and furnace transformers, as well as rectifiers, railway duty, etc.; distribution transformers for utilities, boards, and private industries; and instrument transformers, including current and potential transformers. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.

TIPSMUSIC.NS.d: Tips Music Limited mainly acquires and monetises music copyrights in India and internationally. It also creates and acquires audiovisual musical works, earns revenue by digitally monetising its content library, and organises and manages live performances.

VIPCLOTHNG.NS.d: VIP Clothing Limited manufactures, markets, and distributes garments in India. It offers innerwear and socks for men and women under the VIP, Frenchie, Feelings, Leader, and Brat brands. The company operates through 550 dealer network and 110,000 retail outlets in India. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Maxwell Industries Limited and changed its name to VIP Clothing Limited in October 2016. VIP Clothing Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

WELSPLSOL.NS.d: Welspun Specialty Solutions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker WELSPLSOL and traded in INR. Its country is India.
